svg.title: Pero Paper: 04 · Review the record
svg.desc: The Research record sidebar shows date-grouped questions and saved statuses, selected report detail, an unverified-conclusion notice, a citation pointing back to page 2, limitations, and Continue from here. Simplified editorial UI schematic based on user-supplied library and selected-PDF/shared-Chat screenshots reviewed on 2026-11-07, whose application revision is unknown. Older controlled fixture captures inform import and reader layout; Paper source at c12c2ab0 supplements the unscreened record/report state. Titles, collections, counts, page numbers, questions, dates, and document lines are illustrative placeholders, not user data or research findings. Gold is editorial emphasis, not verification. No live GUI, fixed-version, scientific-quality, native-package, or production acceptance is claimed.
